<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | Functional core / imperative shell; constructorinjection; storage-neutral pureadapters; standard-first typedlogrecords, no alternatepersistedmodel; explicitcontentpolicy and boundedI/O. |
| composition_root | crates/app/src/main.rs selects explicitstaticadapter and composes SDK genericcollectionservice with FileSessionLoader and OtlpJsonlWriter. |
| contracts | Source separation: SessionLoader owns listing/storage/framing; SessionAdapter is a pure deterministic data mapper and receives no reader, filesystem, environment, clock, writer, service locator or loader. SDK orchestrates three independently injectable ports. Adapters never open sidecars or attachment paths. Preserve existing configuration APIs., New core collection types in crates/core/src/collection.rs: SourceScope { root: PathBuf, max_sessions: usize }; SessionRef { path: PathBuf }; SourceIdentity = Unix { device:u64, inode:u64 } \| Unavailable; ReadCursor { source:PathBuf, identity:SourceIdentity, offset:u64 }; ReadLimits { max_records:usize, max_record_bytes:usize, max_batch_bytes:usize }, default 128/1048576/4194304, positive and max_batch_bytes&gt;=max_record_bytes. NativeRecord { offset:u64, bytes:Vec&lt;u8&gt; }; LoadedBatch { source:SessionRef, records:Vec&lt;NativeRecord&gt;, next_cursor:ReadCursor, more:bool, incomplete_tail:bool }. No semantic sessionId is invented from a file path., SessionLoader: Send+Sync; fn list_sessions(&self,scope:&SourceScope)-&gt;Result&lt;Vec&lt;SessionRef&gt;,PipelineError&gt;; fn read_batch(&self,session:&SessionRef,cursor:Option&lt;&ReadCursor&gt;,limits:ReadLimits)-&gt;Result&lt;LoadedBatch,PipelineError&gt;. Explicit absolute file/root required. File loader listing is deliberately NONRECURSIVE for this first slice: immediate regular .jsonl files in the explicit directory, sorted by native path, reject oversize result rather than truncate silently; skip symlink entries. Read an explicitly selected regular file, reject final symlink (Unix nofollow), never autodiscover sidecars. Directory ancestors are caller-selected trusted scope, not a hostile-filesystem sandbox claim., Loader semantics: bounded LF framing, NativeRecord bytes exclude LF but retain CR; blank lines consume physical max_records budget and cursor but are omitted from returned records. Never allocate based on full file length. Observe end-of-file length once per call; do not chase live appends. Incomplete final bytes cause incomplete_tail=true and cursor remains after last complete LF; more=false at that observed boundary so CLI does not spin. A capacity stop with unread complete/unknown bytes sets more=true. ReadCursor binds exact selected path, identity and boundary offset; wrong path, source rotation/truncation, non-boundary offset or unsupported resume identity is a typed error, not automatic reset. Same-inode in-place rewriting/regrowth cannot be fully detected and is explicitly unsupported; no exactly-once/source-journal promise., Pure result types: TelemetryRecord { event_name:String, timestamp_unix_nano:Option&lt;u64&gt;, attributes:BTreeMap&lt;String,serde_json::Value&gt;, body:Option&lt;serde_json::Value&gt; }; MappingOptions { include_content:bool } defaults false; MappingDiagnostic { offset:u64, code:MappingDiagnosticCode }; MappingDiagnosticCode = UnsupportedRecord \| UnsupportedPart \| InvalidField \| InvalidTimestamp \| ContentOmitted; MappedBatch { records:Vec&lt;TelemetryRecord&gt;, diagnostics:Vec&lt;MappingDiagnostic&gt; }. SessionAdapter: Send+Sync; fn name(&self)-&gt;&'static str; fn map(&self, source:&SessionRef, records:&[NativeRecord], options:MappingOptions)-&gt;Result&lt;MappedBatch,PipelineError&gt;. This slice emits source-derived record fragments, not reconstructed whole conversations, so no speculative adapter state object is required. Replay of equal input yields equal mapping., Failure contract: separate PipelineError with public PipelineErrorKind = InvalidInput \| Read \| SourceChanged \| Limit \| InvalidData \| Write \| Unsupported; PipelineError::new(kind:PipelineErrorKind,offset:Option&lt;u64&gt;)-&gt;Self, kind()/offset()/code()/message()/fix() accessors; fixed code/message/fix, Display/Error, no raw serde/OS/source bytes in diagnostics. Codes UNI-INPUT/UNI-READ/UNI-SOURCE-CHANGED/UNI-LIMIT/UNI-DATA/UNI-WRITE/UNI-UNSUPPORTED. No changes to existing configuration Failure taxonomy., Claude mapping profile v1: each supported physical record emits event_name=unisphere.session.record, an explicitly nonstandard source-derived event, NEVER falsely gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details. All outputs have unisphere.profile.version=1, unisphere.source.adapter=claude-code, unisphere.source.path (explicit supplied UTF8path), unisphere.source.offset (physical byte offset) and unisphere.source.kind. Native uuid-&gt;unisphere.source.record.id, parentUuid-&gt;unisphere.source.parent.id, message.id-&gt;unisphere.message.id, declared sessionId-&gt;gen_ai.conversation.id when present. isSidechain preserves unisphere.source.is_sidechain; never infer ownership/parentsession relationship. Repeated message.id records remain distinct by provenance; do not dedupe or sum their usage. Only observed message.model -&gt; gen_ai.response.model; never invent provider name or trace/span IDs., Content mapping: supported user/assistant native records have message role retained as unisphere.message.role; when include_content=true, body is a structured GenAI-shaped message {role,parts}, not stringified JSON and not claimed full input-history/output-choice. Native string content -&gt; text part; text.text -&gt; {type:text,content}; thinking.thinking -&gt; {type:reasoning,content}; tool_use -&gt; {type:tool_call,id?,name,arguments:structured input}; tool_result -&gt; {type:tool_call_response,id:tool_use_id?,response:structured content}. Preserve is_error as explicitly namespaced part property unisphere.is_error when supplied. Unknown part -&gt; diagnostic and optional generic part {type:unisphere.unknown,native_type,...} only with content opt-in; document not full-byte fidelity. Metadata-only drops all message bodies/tool arguments/results/thinking/unknown payloads and records ContentOmitted plus unisphere.content.omitted=true when content exists. No attachment dereference. Unknown record kind returns provenance-only record plus UnsupportedRecord diagnostic, no rawpayload by default or invisible dropping., Claude timestamp: parse native RFC3339 with time crate, convert valid nonnegative nanoseconds fittingu64 into timestamp_unix_nano; missing remains None, invalid/out-ofrange omitted with diagnostic, never stamp wallclock inside mapper. Usage numbers must be nonnegative representable integers; retain native component counters in unisphere.usage.* source-snapshot attributes, scope explicitly native_record_snapshot. Do NOT emit gen_ai.usage totals or aggregate across repeated records until provider counter inclusion semantics are proven; no absent-&gt;zero or overlapping cache addition. This is the smallest documented semantic extension rather than falsely standardizing an unverified total., Output port RecordWriter: Send+Sync; fn write_batch(&self, records:&[TelemetryRecord], destination:&mut dyn std::io::Write)-&gt;Result&lt;(),PipelineError&gt;. OtlpJsonlWriter owns encoding only, no file open/env/network. One nonempty batch -&gt; one LF-terminated LogsData object {resourceLogs:[{scopeLogs:[{scope:{name:unisphere,version:0.1.0},logRecords:[...]}]}]}. Empty batch emits nothing and succeeds. record eventName/timeUnixNano/body/attributes follow lowerCamelCase OTLP. AnyValue recursively uses stringValue/boolValue/intValue decimalstring/doubleValue/arrayValue.values/kvlistValue.values; JSON null-&gt;empty AnyValue {}; reject JSON integer outside i64 instead of changing its meaning. timeUnixNano is u64decimalstring; no fake trace IDs, no mixedsignals. Complete serialization into a bounded batch buffer before writing; write_all+flush and return typedWrite on failure. Write failure may leave partial bytes; no rollback/exactly-once promise., SDK service collects a single batch through public fn collect_batch(loader:&dyn SessionLoader,adapter:&dyn SessionAdapter,writer:&dyn RecordWriter,session:&SessionRef,cursor:Option&lt;&ReadCursor&gt;,limits:ReadLimits,options:MappingOptions,destination:&mut dyn Write)-&gt;Result&lt;CollectionBatch,PipelineError&gt;. CollectionBatch { mapped:MappedBatch,next_cursor:ReadCursor,more:bool,incomplete_tail:bool }. It validates bounded loader output against supplied limits, invokes pure mapper, writes mapped records then returns checkpoint only on success; no source/output mutation or cursor persistence hidden in SDK. Reexport core collection contracts from SDK. CLI may loop batches, but no durable checkpoint file or watchdaemon in this slice; SDKcaller owns cursor persistence and output acceptance policy., CLI/PMcomposition: add sessions list --root ABS_PATH and sessions export --adapter claude-code --input ABS_PATH [--output PATH] [--include-content] [--max-records N] [--max-record-bytes N] [--max-batch-bytes N]. Relative CLIpaths resolved against explicit CliContext.cwd; SDKrequires absolute. List uses versioned JSON on stdout; export always emits OTLPJSONL stdout or create_new explicit outputfile, no silent overwrite. Export summary/diagnostics go stderr, never telemetry stdout. Invalidargs exit2, operational errors1, success0; incomplete tail reports honest partial summary and stops. Keep existing config check/help/version behavior; roothelp advertises sessionscommands. App selects adapters by explicit staticregistry/factory; no dynamicplugins or envdiscovery. CLIfrontend uses injected collection functions/port, never direct concrete adapter imports; app is concretecomposition boundary., Crates: new unisphere-loader-jsonl -&gt; core + targetunix libc; unisphere-adapter-claude -&gt; core+serde_json+time (parsing,std only); unisphere-output-otlp -&gt; core+serde_json. Core adds serde_json solely for structured portable values; no fs/env/network/process/unsafe. Each newcrate devdepends testkit. Existing SDK collection service imports only corecontracts/stdtypes. PMapp composition depends on SDK/CLI and concrete newcrates. Constructor injection, no globalstate. Newtime/libc direct deps declared once in root atbaseline; no source-shaped custom JSON parser/date parser. Dependencychecks updated to reflect actual approvedgraph, including existing SDKdirectserde., Extension affordance: testkit supplies reusable pure-adapter conformance helper asserting determinism/source-provenance/contentpolicy/outputbounds on fixture inputs. docs/adapters.md includes a complete functional synthetic text-record adapter example and one explicit app registration entry; a test proves it composes through public interfaces without core/Claude edits. Do not create a dynamic plugin framework or a generator that emits fake success/TODO implementation; shared contracts+workingtemplate are the scaffolding for ordinary next adapters., Knownruntime posture: Builder remains dogfood with useful CLIrecords and honestwarnings. Never lose work or fabricate proof when ownership/receipt tooling blocks; report exactissue and apply already-authorized non-destructive workflow workaround. Preserve requested independent Opusreview and actualproduct tests. Coders author fullcode/tests/docs, PMruns validation; PM mechanicalformat/integration ownership must be explicit rather than repeated baseline ceremony. No private stores, no networksource, no remote publish/globalconfig/retirement. |
